source_detail: Dodge/Cummins Factory Service Manual (1998 VIN 6/D) — per AERA TB070424
notes: Factory spec for 12V era (1989-1998). Note the top ring is WIDER than the second ring here — that's correct for this era. Cummins later switched to wide-second-ring philosophy starting in 2000. ⚠️ WARNING: Many Cummins builders consider this OEM/factory spec too tight for any modified or performance application. For builds above stock — including stock-tune trucks under heavy load — the Mahle Diesel-Turbocharged minimum (Bore × 0.006 / 0.0055) is widely considered safer. See the Mahle entries below for the recommended specs.
QuickServe tolerances are more generous than the factory service manual.
Mahle 2022 published minimum for Diesel-Turbocharged: Top = bore × 0.006, Second = bore × 0.0055. These are MINIMUMS — many ring sets ship pre-gapped wider out of the box.
